item.content:encoded:
• tls - Where does SSL encryption take place?
    • Recap: OSI layer 6 or layer 5.... not that important.
    • Run:
    • Resolution:
      • Layer 6 Syntax layer or Presentation layer
        • the most famous one is TLS, MIME in email and PGP.
      • Layer 5: Session layer.
        • most famous one:SOCKS
          • and RTP Real-time Transport Protocol
    • Reason:
      • Pro: ehm more #terminology for you.
      • Con: OSI model is overly complex.
